answers.q4: It returns "1.0 quadrillion". The value rounds up to 1000 trillion, so the carry bumps the ordinal past the 4 compact suffixes, and the code falls back to the word form.
answers.q5: intword(1_234_000, "%0.3f", compact=True) == "1.234M"; intword(999_499, "%.0f", compact=True) == "999K"; intword(999_500, "%.0f", compact=True) == "1M".
